includes: preflight fake runs cost nothing and share no budget

case_selection.rule: sorted(random.Random(seed).sample(sorted(eligible_case_ids), sample_size)); executed once before any provider output was observed; no substitution afterwards

VEGO_AI_OFF.workflow: one direct per-case call with the same model, domain description, candidate model, output schema and ceiling

VEGO_AI_ON.prompts: protected agent prompt templates, bound by the runtime digests above
VEGO_AI_ON.round_loop: MAX_QA_ROUNDS as shipped in the protected orchestrator
VEGO_AI_ON.workflow: unmodified four-agent VEGO-AI pipeline: Language Advisor, Domain Advisor, Model Inspector, Variability Explorer

detector_v1.role: reporting-only candidate-for-human-review label on recorded ON episodes; never writes a human queue, never alters an answer or model, never causes a retry

forbidden_conclusions: Detector-v1 alerts are correct (no human labels exist).
VEGO-AI is universally better, or better on quality (no ground truth, no rated quality yet).
One condition is superior because of cost alone.
OFF produced zero alerts (Detector-v1 is NOT_APPLICABLE under OFF).
Fixture or preflight output is empirical evidence.
A model judgement is a human judgement.
Results generalise beyond this corpus, model, day and configuration.

human_assessment.cards: blinded redacted cards generated into the private root; only their count and digests are published

metrics.definition: output completeness: per-case shared-contract artifact produced (COMPLETED) versus NOT_PRODUCED/SCHEMA_INVALID/TECHNICAL_FAILURE
structural validity: artifact validates against study2-condition-output-v1 with consistent coverage summary
execution cost: provider requests, prompt and completion tokens, priced USD from recorded usage
metrics.denominator: per condition, with ON setting-level cost shown separately and per case attributed

metrics.definition: elapsed wall-clock seconds per condition; OFF per case exact, ON per case as first-to-last attributed request span under concurrency 2
technical failure rate: cases with TECHNICAL_FAILURE, STOPPED_AT_CAP or NOT_PRODUCED; retried requests counted
availability of explainable communication evidence: recorded inter-agent Q&A episodes, questions, answers per case
metrics.denominator: paired cases; OFF is structurally zero by design, reported as NOT_AVAILABLE not as a deficit

metrics.definition: communication metrics: episodes, rounds, termination reasons, source-target routes, answer confidence distribution
Detector-v1 candidate labels: STRONG_ALERT, WEAK_ALERT, NO_ALERT, EXCLUDED per episode; NO_EPISODE per case without episodes
metrics.denominator: scientifically complete ON episodes; NOT_APPLICABLE under OFF

metrics.definition: business-relevance descriptors: cost per completed artifact, requests per completed artifact, share of cases with any candidate-for-review label
blinded human assessment: REVIEW_WORTHY / NOT_REVIEW_WORTHY / INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION per redacted card; agreement, correctness, precision, recall, F1, workload, benefit
metrics.denominator: cards scored by two independent raters

retry_policy.parse_reattempts: protected LLMClient MAX_PARSE_RETRIES=2 applies identically to both conditions; each re-attempt is a metered request
retry_policy.retry_condition: APIConnectionError, APITimeoutError, RateLimitError, InternalServerError, asyncio timeout; never on a valid response

stopping_rule: run every planned unit once; stop only on cap, ceiling, run timeout, model mismatch, credential absence or gate failure; never on observed results

technical_failure_policy.NOT_PRODUCED: no artifact for that case and condition; stays in the denominator of M1 and M5
technical_failure_policy.SCHEMA_INVALID: artifact fails the shared contract; counted in M2, excluded from structural descriptors, never repaired
technical_failure_policy.STOPPED_AT_CAP: a cap or the ceiling was reached; remaining cases reported as not produced
technical_failure_policy.TECHNICAL_FAILURE: provider, parse, model-mismatch or secret-detection failure; reported per case with request count
technical_failure_policy.ZERO_EPISODES_UNDER_ON: valid observation, Detector-v1 contribution NO_EPISODE, distinct from NO_ALERT and NOT_APPLICABLE
